cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've laid out the buses I missed while you had my keys. Read the times from left to right, please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Waiting time and consequences are separate measures. Three buses here; cold dinner here. Please don't put the receipt on top of the timetable.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy you another dinner. Can we clear the table?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's compensation, not an apology. Say you're sorry for keeping the keys and I'll stop the reconstruction. We can use the table for your new dinner.

reason: Make A expert timeline corrections maintain the visible inconvenience until B offers the specific apology, while accepting B meal repair as a practical next step.
